user_ambition_verbatim: Ensure all reviews are addressed and do whatever necessary to make paper great.

target_venue.name: International Journal of Remote Sensing
target_venue.acceptance_bar: A novel and operationally consequential remote-sensing reliability audit with information-matched baselines, multiple independent seeds, measured-GSD multi-event evidence, leakage controls, valid uncertainty, and fully reproducible artifacts.

great_claim: Reference-dependent multi-scale consistency can substantially overstate reliability gains under spatial-resolution shift because it compares a received coarse image with unavailable finer views. A preregistered information-matched audit on exact-hash-clean AIDER data, independent AIDER and Hurricane model seeds, and leakage-free paired measured-GSD CRASAR sites identifies this inflation, tests current deployable EO reliability baselines fairly, and provides evidence-backed deployment guidance.
win_condition: On three independently trained seeds per primary corpus: (W1) the privileged-minus-deployable consistency AUROC advantage is positive on both AIDER and Hurricane, with a paired bootstrap 95% interval excluding zero; (W2) all compared deployable scores use only the received image and identical source training/validation information, including confidence, EO-kNN, ViM, energy, and received-image consistency; (W3) exact-hash AIDER deduplication and guarded CRASAR spatial blocks yield zero audited cross-split duplicates/intersections; (W4) paired measured-GSD evaluation includes at least four sites, two disaster events, three model seeds, a classifier above the majority baseline, site-level results, and spatial-cluster uncertainty; (W5) every negative result, protocol deviation, and superseded contaminated result is retained and linked to execution proof.
kill_criteria: Restart if privileged-information inflation does not replicate on both primary corpora, if leakage-free measured-GSD evidence cannot be produced with a classifier above the majority baseline, if current EO baselines cannot be compared under matched information, or if novelty search finds an existing remote-sensing study already combining privileged-view inflation measurement, exact-hash and spatial-overlap audits, and multi-event paired measured-GSD reliability evaluation.
anti_goals: Claiming the failed received-image RCG is operationally superior
Treating unavailable fine-resolution views as deployable inputs
Hiding negative threshold-transfer or leakage findings
Reusing contaminated AIDER or overlapping CRASAR endpoints as primary evidence
Paid APIs, cloud or HPC compute, new human labels, or human rating panels
Downgrading the locked IJRS greatness bar
